verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's docs confirm it offers external status pages, both FireHydrant-hosted and via Atlassian, alongside internal status pages. Incident updates posted via `/fh update` or Command Center flow to the internal per-incident status page, but the pack never shows that incident state drives the hosted public page. missing for 10: custom domain support, subscriber notifications, documented incident-state-driven updates to the external hosted page, independent or hands-on corroboration.
